title: OCC Packet and Channel Contract Specification
description: Standardized framing and physical parameters shared between transmitter_sim and receiver_demod. Version 1.1 — updated by @sim-agent 2026-11-24.

preamble.description: Alternating synchronization sequence for clock recovery and frame alignment (transmitted FIRST)

crc.name: CRC-4-ITU
crc.description: 4-bit CRC-4-ITU cyclic redundancy check over [preamble (8-bit) + node_id (8-bit)] = 16 input bits

packet_structure.description: 20-bit packet cycles repeatedly from top to bottom of the LED aperture rows

led_specs.description: Physical LED emitter parameters. At baseline f_led=2500Hz, t_row=25us: pixels_per_bit=8, safely above 2-pixel Nyquist limit.

rolling_shutter.description: t_row=25us => f_sample=40kHz (1/t_row). Full frame readout time = 1080 * 25us = 27ms.

pinhole_model.description: Simplified pinhole model using focal_length_px directly (no sensor pixel pitch needed when focal length is in pixel units)

modulation.description: On-Off Keying. At 2500Hz modulation and 25us row time: 8 pixel rows per bit symbol.

ipc.description: File-based IPC paths for inter-agent and live-demo frame passing. Paths are relative to the repository root.
